correctness.rationale: Independence gives the Poisson-binomial variance sum; a direct factorization derives the exact balancing gap, whose only possible sign change is a monotone scalar root. The bound (1+q)(q^a+q^{b-1})<=q(1+q)^2 proves all-size sharpness via (1,3). Finite integer balancing proves global minimality; high-q reversal follows from a uniform finite-size bound; exact nine-species examples have independently verified rational variances. Standalone polynomial and exhaustive independent-loss checks replayed.

value.rationale: The precisely motivated functional-richness variance is distinct from expected functional loss; the uniform, sharp q threshold for every size/allocation and the exact local sign classification establish a structural regime of concordance and failure. The two opposite exact signs under the same S=9,F=3,q=1/2 make the distinction operationally interpretable within the model, without pretending empirical forecasting or a new elementary reliability formula.
